title: Count the total number of languages
description:
Write a function `total_languages(path)` that reads the country data JSON file at `path` and returns the number of distinct languages spoken across every country.

`countries_data.json` is available in your working directory - 250 real countries, each with a `languages` list.

hints: Idea to consider: collect every language into a set to drop duplicates
Each country's 'languages' list can repeat languages other countries also speak - a set automatically keeps only one copy of each distinct value as you add to it.
Load the JSON file, loop through every country's languages adding each to a set (or build the set directly with a comprehension), then return len(that set).
expected_behavior: Returns the count of distinct languages across all countries in the file.
explanation: A set comprehension over every (country, language) pair collapses all the duplicates in one pass - counting distinct values is exactly what a set is for.
